title: Toast notices
summary: toast(text, kind, opts) shows a notice (info or error) with optional action buttons and duration, de-duplicates an identical notice already showing, keeps clear of the pointer, and records the last 100 in a history that a notices dialog can list.
description: Notices mount in `#toast-root`. The same text already showing is kept in place and its timer restarted; `ms: 0` keeps a notice until dismissed. `noticeHistory()` returns the last 100 (same text twice in a row is one entry with a count); `onNoticeHistory` lets a dialog stay current. Display time is `opts.ms`, else 10 s with actions, else the `noticeSeconds` preference, else 6 s for errors and 3.6 s for info. Style rules (`cv-toast*`) are in `dialogs.css`.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.signature: export interface NoticeAction { label: string; run: () => void }
exports.doc: A button on a notice: label and handler.

exports.signature: export interface NoticeOptions { actions?: NoticeAction[]; ms?: number }
exports.doc: Optional actions and display milliseconds; 0 keeps the notice until dismissed.

exports.signature: export interface NoticeRecord { id: number; text: string; kind: 'info' | 'error'; at: number; count: number }
exports.doc: One history entry: id, text, kind, time and repeat count.
Every notice shown, oldest first, the last 100; the same text twice in a row is one entry with a count.
Empties the history and tells the watchers.
Registers a watcher called when the history changes; returns the unsubscribe function.

exports.signature: export function toast(text: string, kind: 'info' | 'error' = 'info', opts: NoticeOptions = {}): () => void
exports.doc: A notice. The same text already showing is kept where it is and shown for its full time again, rather than stacked a second time, which would push the others up the screen.

invariants.text: Build a node once, then patch text, classes, hidden flags and lists in place. Never assign innerHTML or clear textContent on a live container to rebuild it, and reserve space so nothing shifts when content arrives.
Stacking above local ordering uses var(--z-*) from the one z scale; a raw numeric z-index is not allowed.
Icons are inline currentColor SVG strings from the icons module (icon(name, size)); no icon library, and the three-star sparkle icon is banned under any name.

examples.title: Error notice from a failed promise
examples.snippet: void file.text().then((text) => { s.develop = developFromXmp(text); for (const f of devSync) f(); this.schedule(); }).catch((err: unknown) => toast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'The settings could not be read.', 'error'));
examples.whenToUse: Surface a recoverable failure without a dialog.
